how.title: How a focus session works | {app}
how.description: From booking to the closing check-in: session lengths, matching, etiquette, and safety.
how.heading: A simple rhythm for focused work
how.lead: A focus session gives your task a beginning and an end, with another person working alongside you.

stages.title: Before: choose a manageable task
stages.body: Book a session for 25, 50, or 75 minutes. Set out what you need, test your camera, and close unrelated tabs. Pick a goal you can describe in a sentence.

stages.title: Intro: say hello and share your goal
stages.body: Join on time with your camera on. Give your partner a brief greeting and name what you will work on. Your tasks do not need to be related. Keep personal details private.

stages.title: Focus: work quietly together
stages.body: Keep your camera on and work on your own task. Your microphone is optional; mute it when you are not speaking. If your attention drifts, return to the next small action.

stages.title: Wrap-up: tell each other how it went
stages.body: Share what you did and mark your outcome as done, partial, or not done. You can make progress without finishing. Thank your partner and take a break before another session.

how.matchingBody: We match people with the same start time and session length, prioritizing preferred and favorite partners while respecting blocks. Your partner is assigned five minutes before the session. A late booking is matched as soon as possible.
how.fallbackBody: If nobody is available, you can join the open room, move to the next slot with someone waiting, or cancel without penalty. A booking does not guarantee a one-on-one partner.
how.etiquetteTitle: A shared space, with simple expectations
how.etiquetteBody: Keep your camera on. Your microphone is optional. Be kind, keep greetings brief, and respect quiet work. Do not record, promote services, or comment on someone’s appearance.
how.safetyBody: The service is for adults 18 and older. We never record sessions. You can leave, report, or block someone; blocks prevent future matching. Keep sensitive information out of view.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions | {app}
faqPage.description: Answers about getting started, focus sessions, safety, privacy, and plans.
faqPage.heading: Questions, answered
faqPage.lead: Here is what to expect before you book a little company for your work.

items.a: Body doubling means doing your own task with another person present. On a video session, you share a goal, work quietly, and check in at the end. It is a practical work routine, not medical treatment.
Adults 18 and older can use the service for work, studying, writing, or everyday tasks. You do not need a diagnosis or a particular kind of job.

items.q: What do I need for my first session?
items.a: A working camera, an internet connection, and one task. Choose a private, appropriate setting and test your camera before the session.
Choose 25, 50, or 75 minutes. Sessions start on the hour or half hour. Your calendar displays times in your time zone.
We match people with the same start time and length, with preferred and favorite partners first. Blocks are always respected. Your partner is assigned five minutes before the start.

items.q: What if there is nobody to match with?
items.a: You can join the open room, move to the next slot with someone waiting, or cancel without penalty. Matching depends on who has booked.

items.q: Do I have to speak or share my screen?
items.a: Keep your camera on. Your microphone is optional, and you can keep it muted while working. You do not need to share your screen or explain private details.

items.q: What if I do not finish my goal?
items.a: Mark your outcome as partial or not done and share a brief, honest check-in. A session is a place to work, not a test you have to pass.
Cancel at least one hour before the start to avoid a late cancellation. If you cannot attend, cancel rather than leaving a partner waiting. Unmatched fallback cancellations have no penalty.
No. We never record or store session video or audio. Your partner can still see your surroundings, so keep sensitive information out of view. Recording other participants is prohibited.

items.q: How do I report or block someone?
items.a: Use the report or block controls in the session. Reporting also blocks the person and sends details to our team. You will not be matched with a blocked person again.

items.q: Can I export or delete my data?
items.a: Use data export and account deletion in Settings. Contact support if you need help exercising your privacy rights. Our privacy policy explains retention and legal exceptions.
Free includes three sessions a week, matching, and streaks. When billing is disabled on an instance, all members have Plus access.

Plus includes unlimited sessions, favorite partners, and advanced matching filters. Where billing is enabled, you can choose monthly or yearly billing with a seven-day free trial. The yearly plan is billed yearly.

items.q: How do I cancel a subscription?
items.a: Open the billing customer portal in Settings. Cancel before your trial ends to avoid its first charge, or before renewal to avoid the next charge. Checkout and the portal show the applicable dates and amounts.

walkthrough.title: How a session works
walkthrough.subtitle: A 60-second visual walkthrough of body doubling in {app}.
walkthrough.step1Desc: Pick a 25, 50, or 75-minute session on the schedule board. Sessions start on the hour and half-hour.
walkthrough.step2Desc: Five minutes before your start time, we pair you with an accountability partner and send you a link to your room.
walkthrough.step3Desc: Join with camera on. Exchange a friendly greeting, state your one concrete goal, and set your intention.
walkthrough.step4Desc: Microphones mute automatically. The Pace Clock sweeps through the focus interval while you work quietly side-by-side.
walkthrough.step5Desc: The chime rings. Unmute, share what you accomplished, mark your outcome as done, and celebrate showing up.

tour.stepBookDesc: Schedule a 25, 50, or 75-minute session whenever you need accountability. Sessions start on the hour and half-hour.
tour.stepUpcomingDesc: When you have booked sessions, your active lane appears here with the live Pace Clock and one-click room access.
tour.stepSuggestionsDesc: See slots where other people are already waiting for a partner. One click to reserve your lane.
tour.stepPeopleDesc: Save partners you enjoyed working with to match with them first, and share your personal booking link.
tour.stepProgressDesc: Build a daily streak, track your cumulative focus hours, and celebrate your consistency.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {appName} — what to expect
welcome.heading: Welcome to {appName}
welcome.line1: {appName} pairs you 1:1 on video to get your most important work done in quiet focus lanes.
welcome.line2: Sessions start on the hour and half-hour. Cameras stay on, you share your goal in the first minute, mute your mic, and focus heads-down.
welcome.line3: You get three free sessions every week. Pick a 25, 50, or 75-minute slot to try your first session.

nudgeFirstBooking.subject: Ready for your first focus session?
nudgeFirstBooking.heading: Get your first session on the calendar
nudgeFirstBooking.line1: It takes less than a minute to book your first session on {appName}.
nudgeFirstBooking.line2: Whether you are writing, studying, tackling admin work, or coding, having a quiet partner waiting makes starting effortless.
nudgeFirstBooking.line3: Free cancellation is available up to an hour before the session starts.

firstSessionTips.subject: Tips for your first focus session today
firstSessionTips.heading: Your first session starts in one hour
firstSessionTips.line1: Here is what to prepare before you join:
firstSessionTips.line2: 1. Pick one specific, bite-sized task so you know exactly what to share during the intro.
firstSessionTips.line3: 2. Have water ready and close distracting browser tabs.
firstSessionTips.line4: 3. Camera on is required, but your microphone will be muted during focus time.

afterFirstSession.subject: Nice work on your first session
afterFirstSession.heading: You finished your first session
afterFirstSession.line1: Great job showing up and finishing your first focus session.
afterFirstSession.line2: Building momentum is easier with a weekly streak: complete at least one session every week to keep your streak alive.
afterFirstSession.line3: Coworking is even better with people you know. Invite a friend and you both get a free month of Plus when they complete their first session.

winBack.subject: Jump back into a focus session
winBack.heading: We saved your focus lane
winBack.line1: It has been two weeks since your last focus session on {appName}.
winBack.line2: If you have a project you have been putting off or need an hour of dedicated, quiet momentum, jump back in.
winBack.line3: Your three free sessions reset every week.

cookiesPage.title: Cookies and browser storage | {app}
cookiesPage.heading: Cookies & browser storage
cookiesPage.lead: {app} is built with privacy by default. We do not use third-party advertising cookies or cross-site tracking profiles.
cookiesPage.overviewText: We use only essential cookies by default to keep you securely signed in and remember your language preference. Functional browser storage is used strictly to store your interface settings such as color theme. If analytics is enabled, PostHog operates in a cookieless mode before consent, and optional usage metrics are sent only after you explicitly opt in.
cookiesPage.rowSessionPurpose: Maintains your secure signed-in session and authenticates API requests.
cookiesPage.rowLocalePurpose: Remembers your chosen language so you see translated pages consistently.
cookiesPage.rowThemePurpose: Stores your chosen interface color theme (light or dark) in your browser.
cookiesPage.rowAttrCookiePurpose: Functional first-touch attribution data (source, medium, campaign, referrer, landing page) without storing any personal identifier.
cookiesPage.rowConsentPurpose: Remembers whether you accepted or declined optional usage analytics.
cookiesPage.rowAnalyticsPurpose: When consent is granted, captures feature usage events to help us improve the app. Runs cookieless before consent.
cookiesPage.manageText: You can block or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will prevent you from signing in to your {app} account.

accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility statement | {app}
accessibilityPage.heading: Accessibility statement
accessibilityPage.lead: {app} is designed to provide an inclusive, quiet, and structured focus environment for everyone, including neurodivergent individuals and people with disabilities.
accessibilityPage.standardText: We are committed to digital accessibility and aim to conform with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA standard.
accessibilityPage.featSemantic: Semantic HTML: Proper landmarks, heading hierarchy, and ARIA attributes for screen readers.
accessibilityPage.featContrast: High-contrast palette: Swimming lane-inspired themes calibrated to exceed WCAG AA contrast ratios in both light and dark modes.
accessibilityPage.featMotion: Reduced motion support: Strict adherence to prefers-reduced-motion preferences, disabling non-essential transitions and animations.
accessibilityPage.featKeyboard: Keyboard operability: Full keyboard navigation with visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibilityPage.featTouch: Touch target sizing: Minimum 44×44px hit targets for buttons, inputs, and controls.
accessibilityPage.featTabular: Tabular numerals: Monospaced numeric alignment on timers, clocks, and stats to prevent visual jitter.
accessibilityPage.featQuiet: Low cognitive load: Calmed visual lanes, muted microphones during focus sets, and absence of unsolicited notification sounds.
accessibilityPage.limVideo: Live participant video: Because video is streamed peer-to-peer from participants' webcams, lighting conditions and background contrast depend on each individual user.
accessibilityPage.limWebRTC: Browser WebRTC compatibility: Some assistive technologies may experience varied behavior inside active WebRTC video elements depending on the browser engine.
accessibilityPage.feedbackText: If you experience any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us via our <contactLink>contact form</contactLink> or email us at {email}. We welcome your feedback and aim to respond within 2 business days.

communityGuidelinesPage.title: Community guidelines | {app}
communityGuidelinesPage.heading: Community guidelines
communityGuidelinesPage.lead: {app} is a quiet, supportive space for focused work. These guidelines ensure every session is safe, respectful, and distraction-free.
communityGuidelinesPage.principleRespect: Mutual respect: Treat every focus partner with courtesy and kindness. People join from diverse backgrounds, neurotypes, and professions.
communityGuidelinesPage.principlePresence: Visual presence: Keep your camera turned on so your partner benefits from the body-doubling effect.
communityGuidelinesPage.principleQuiet: Quiet focus: Keep microphones muted throughout the main focus period to maintain deep concentration.
communityGuidelinesPage.cameraClothing: Clothing: Wear everyday casual clothing suitable for a public workspace or library.
communityGuidelinesPage.cameraWorkspace: Workspace: Set up your camera so your work area or face is visible, showing you are working.
communityGuidelinesPage.cameraEnvironment: Environment: Avoid distracting background activity, inappropriate artwork, or bright flashing lights.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedNudity: Nudity, partial nudity, or sexually suggestive conduct of any kind.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedHarassment: Harassment, hate speech, bullying, insults, stalking, or discriminatory remarks.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedRecording: Recording, photographing, screenshotting, or distributing session video or audio of other members.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedCommercial: Unsolicited sales pitches, recruiting, promotional links, or commercial solicitation.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedDating: Flirting, romantic overtures, or inappropriate personal advances.
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyText: Your safety and comfort come first. If a partner violates these guidelines or makes you uncomfortable:
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyLeave: Leave immediately: You can exit any session at any time with no penalty.
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyReport: Report the partner: Submit a report describing what occurred. Submitting a report automatically blocks the person so you will never be matched with them again.
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyNoRecording: Note on video: Because sessions are never recorded, please provide specific details in your report.
communityGuidelinesPage.consequencesReview: Every report is reviewed by administrators. Minor infractions receive warnings.
communityGuidelinesPage.consequencesThreeReports: Automatic safety hold: Receiving 3 reports within a 30-day window automatically suspends an account pending manual investigation.
communityGuidelinesPage.consequencesZeroTolerance: Zero tolerance: Serious violations including nudity, harassment, or illegal content result in immediate, permanent account termination.
communityGuidelinesPage.questionsPrompt: Questions about our guidelines or a moderation decision? Contact {email}.
